The '''M-40 "Thunderbolt"''' was a model of [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blaster]]. Produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]], the [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] could fire a long-ranged distance. As a light repeating blaster, the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] had a high rate of fire fed from a power magazine or a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]]-mounted [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]], was over two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, and also possessed a [[Stun/Legends|stun setting]]. Often carried by a support [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] with the required tools and training, legal purchase of such blasters was restricted to the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], [[Planetary Security Forces|planetary defense forces]], and private military contractors.<ref name="AoR CRB" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] conflict that occurred in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="AoR date">The [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] establishes that [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] takes place after the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], an event that occurred during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], dated by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the "Thunderbolt" sold for 2,250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="AoR CRB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The M-40 "Thunderbolt" was mentioned in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook]]'', a [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook released in [[2014]].<ref name="AoR CRB" />
